rows: Response remodelled as oneOf across 3 grant-type schemas (auth-code / refresh-token / client-credentials); doc-alignment only — matches live API Hub wire shape.
No TPP action — align parsers to the documented oneOf; no behaviour change.

International Creditor restructured from flat object to oneOf(Individual/Organization) discriminated by IdentityType — adds name parts, DOB, nationality, source of funds/income, LEI/BIC, identity Evidence.
TPPs sending cross-border payments must populate the new Individual/Organization variant and set IdentityType.
CreditorAgent address unified onto shared AEInternationalAddress; TownName becomes required, maxLength cut 140→70.
TPPs supplying an international Creditor Agent address must include TownName (≤70 chars).

Risk tree (AERisk, DebtorIndicators, TransactionIndicators, CreditorIndicators, DestinationDeliveryAddress) now closed with additionalProperties:false on the Payments side, matching PAR (SupplementaryData blocks remain open).
TPPs sending undeclared Risk properties to /payments, /file-payments or /payment-consents now get validation errors.

Same SWIFT SR2026 Creditor/address restructuring mirrored across the API Hub Consent Manager and the two Ozone Connect LFI-facing specs (no breaking-changes register found for these two Ozone files — open question for next run).
LFIs implementing Ozone Connect must serve the restructured international Creditor/Address shape.

fillBasisNote: Compliance fill is counted over the 8 Tier-1 banks / 16 Tier-1 insurers present in the roster (the cohort whose deadline binds first); Tier-2 early movers shown separately. Production-directory registration is authoritative; sandbox traffic is secondary demand-side evidence.

prodGrid.note: Green = capability exposed in the production Trust Framework directory AND carrying live 2xx traffic in the public logs. Blue = exposed in production but no live 2xx traffic in the window. Hatched = not exposed for that capability in the production directory. Exposure is unambiguously production (production directory); Nebras publishes no per-environment volumes, so 'live' means observed successful traffic on the capability. Payments traffic is measured on initiation, so a 5xx-only initiation flow shows blue, not green.

adoptionNote: LFIs live = banks/insurers with working (2xx) traffic in May–Jun 2026 (last 2 full months) on the release's observable surfaces in the public Nebras logs (R1: consent + payments + CoP + balances + parties; R2: R1 + transactions; Retail R4+: ≥100 v2.1 2xx calls; Insurance/FX: domain traffic). Demand-side evidence only — absence of TPP calls does not prove an LFI is not certified. Intl, SME and bulk scopes are not URL-observable (n/obs). uae-livx is an unconfirmed sandbox LFI key (likely LIVA Insurance B.S.C. by naming pattern) showing atypical AIS/PIS-shaped traffic for an insurer — flagged for verification, not asserted.
